items.title: Maldives Overwater Escape
items.overview: A short flight from the UAE and a world away. This five-day Maldives escape pairs an overwater villa with unhurried days — snorkelling the house reef, spa afternoons and dinners over the lagoon. We tailor the resort tier, meal plan and transfers around your dates and budget.

itinerary.title: Arrival & lagoon sunset
itinerary.detail: Fly from Dubai or Abu Dhabi to Malé, connect by seaplane or speedboat to your resort, and settle into your overwater villa before a welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: House reef & spa
itinerary.detail: Morning snorkelling on the house reef, a relaxed lunch, then a couples' treatment at the overwater spa.

itinerary.title: Island day
itinerary.detail: A free day for water sports, a sandbank picnic or simply the villa deck. Optional excursions can be arranged in advance.

itinerary.title: Dolphin cruise
itinerary.detail: Late-afternoon dolphin cruise followed by a beachfront dinner under the stars.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.detail: Breakfast over the water, transfer back to Malé and your return flight to the UAE.

included: Return economy flights from the UAE
Travel support before and during the trip
travelInfo: Visa on arrival for most UAE residents and many nationalities — we confirm for your passport
Best season: November to April
Flight time from Dubai: about 4 hours

items.title: Istanbul & Cappadocia Discovery
items.overview: Two of Türkiye's greatest experiences in one week: Istanbul's layered old city and Cappadocia's surreal valleys. The pace balances guided mornings with free afternoons, and the famous sunrise balloon flight can be added on your preferred day.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Istanbul
itinerary.detail: Fly from the UAE, private transfer to your hotel near Sultanahmet, evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Old city walking day
itinerary.detail: Guided visits to Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, the Hippodrome and the Basilica Cistern.

itinerary.title: Bazaars & Bosphorus
itinerary.detail: Morning at the Grand Bazaar and Spice Market, evening Bosphorus dinner cruise.

itinerary.title: Fly to Cappadocia
itinerary.detail: Short domestic flight, check in to a cave hotel, sunset viewpoint at Göreme.

itinerary.title: Valleys & workshops
itinerary.detail: Optional sunrise balloon flight, then Göreme Open-Air Museum, Pigeon Valley and a pottery workshop in Avanos.

itinerary.title: Underground city
itinerary.detail: Derinkuyu underground city and Uçhisar Castle, with a free evening in Göreme.

itinerary.title: Return to the UAE
itinerary.detail: Fly to Istanbul and connect home.

travelInfo: Many nationalities receive e-visas; we confirm requirements for your passport
Best seasons: April–June and September–November
Flight time from Dubai: about 5 hours

items.title: Swiss Alps & Lakes Journey
items.overview: Switzerland by train is the easiest 'wow' trip from the UAE — cool summer air, lakes, and mountain excursions that children and grandparents enjoy equally. This self-guided itinerary includes rail passes, hand-picked hotels and a day-by-day plan you can adjust freely.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Zurich
itinerary.detail: Fly from the UAE, train to your hotel, evening walk along the Limmat.

itinerary.title: Zurich & Rhine Falls
itinerary.detail: Old town morning, afternoon excursion to the Rhine Falls.

itinerary.title: To Lucerne
itinerary.detail: Train to Lucerne, Chapel Bridge and lakefront at leisure.

itinerary.title: Mountain day
itinerary.detail: Full-day Mount Titlis excursion with the rotating cable car and glacier park.

itinerary.title: Lake cruise to Interlaken
itinerary.detail: Morning boat on Lake Lucerne, Golden Pass rail to Interlaken.

itinerary.title: Jungfrau region
itinerary.detail: Optional Jungfraujoch 'Top of Europe' excursion or a gentler Harder Kulm afternoon.

itinerary.title: Free day
itinerary.detail: Paragliding, Lake Brienz, or simply Höhematte park and chocolate shopping.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.detail: Train to Zurich Airport and fly home.

travelInfo: Schengen visa required for many residents — we assist with the file
Best seasons: June–September for summer, December–February for snow
Flight time from Dubai: about 7 hours

items.title: Bali Family Adventure
items.overview: Three nights of green Ubud — terraces, waterfalls and temples — followed by two easy beach nights in Nusa Dua. A private driver keeps the pace family-friendly, and every activity can be swapped to suit younger children or teens.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Bali
itinerary.detail: Fly from the UAE to Denpasar, private transfer to your Ubud resort.

itinerary.title: Terraces & temples
itinerary.detail: Tegalalang rice terraces, Tirta Empul water temple and a family cooking class.

itinerary.title: Waterfalls & swings
itinerary.detail: Tibumana waterfall, jungle swing photo stop and free evening in Ubud town.

itinerary.title: To the coast
itinerary.detail: Transfer to Nusa Dua, afternoon on the beach.

itinerary.title: Reef day
itinerary.detail: Optional glass-bottom boat and turtle island trip, sunset dinner on the sand.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.detail: Morning at leisure, transfer to the airport and fly home.

travelInfo: Visa on arrival available for many nationalities — we confirm for your passport
Best season: April to October
Flight time from Dubai: about 8.5 hours

items.title: Georgia Mountains & Old Tbilisi
items.overview: Short flight, big scenery. Georgia has become one of the UAE's favourite quick escapes: cobbled Tbilisi, the drive up the Military Highway to Kazbegi, and long countryside lunches in Kakheti. Excellent value for couples, friends and families alike.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Tbilisi
itinerary.detail: Fly from the UAE, transfer to your hotel, evening stroll through the old town.

itinerary.title: Old Tbilisi
itinerary.detail: Guided walking tour: Narikala fortress by cable car, sulphur bath district, Metekhi church and the bridge of peace.

itinerary.title: Kazbegi day trip
itinerary.detail: Drive the Georgian Military Highway to Kazbegi, 4x4 up to Gergeti Trinity Church, mountain lunch.

itinerary.title: Kakheti countryside
itinerary.detail: Sighnaghi 'city of love', countryside lunch and a relaxed drive back.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.detail: Free morning for shopping, transfer to the airport and fly home.

included: Guided tours and day trips as listed
travelInfo: Visa-free or visa on arrival for many UAE residents — we confirm for your passport
Best seasons: May–October; December–February for snow
Flight time from Dubai: about 3.5 hours

items.title: London Classic City Break
items.overview: The classic London week done comfortably: a central hotel, sightseeing at your own pace, a Thames cruise, and evenings free for the West End or dinner reservations we can arrange. Popular with UAE families for Eid and summer breaks.

itinerary.title: Arrive in London
itinerary.detail: Fly from the UAE, private transfer to your hotel, evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Icons day
itinerary.detail: Hop-on hop-off route past Westminster, Buckingham Palace and Tower Bridge; Thames cruise in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Museums & parks
itinerary.detail: Natural History Museum morning, Hyde Park afternoon, optional West End show.

itinerary.title: Shopping day
itinerary.detail: Free day for Harrods, Oxford Street and Covent Garden.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.detail: Transfer to Heathrow and fly home.

travelInfo: UK visa required for many residents — we assist with the application
Best seasons: May–September; December for festive lights
Flight time from Dubai: about 7.5 hours

items.title: Thailand Islands & Bangkok
items.overview: Two nights of Bangkok's temples, markets and rooftop dinners, then four nights on Phuket's beaches with an island-hopping day to Phi Phi. A balanced first-Thailand itinerary that honeymooners and families both love.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Bangkok
itinerary.detail: Fly from the UAE, transfer to your riverside hotel.

itinerary.title: Temples & river
itinerary.detail: Grand Palace, Wat Pho and Wat Arun, evening Chao Phraya dinner cruise.

itinerary.title: Fly to Phuket
itinerary.detail: Short flight south, check in to your beachfront resort.

itinerary.title: Phi Phi Islands
itinerary.detail: Full-day speedboat trip: Maya Bay viewpoint, snorkelling and island lunch.

itinerary.title: Beach day
itinerary.detail: Free day; optional Old Phuket Town walk and a traditional Thai massage.

itinerary.title: Leisure
itinerary.detail: Pool, beach and a farewell seafood dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.detail: Transfer to Phuket airport and fly home.

included: Phi Phi boat day and listed tours
travelInfo: Visa-free entry for many nationalities — we confirm for your passport
Best season: November to April
Flight time from Dubai: about 6 hours

items.title: Singapore Family Stopover
items.overview: Clean, safe and packed with things children genuinely enjoy — Singapore is the easiest long-weekend city from the UAE. This compact plan covers the icons and leaves room for Universal Studios or the zoo, whichever your family prefers.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Singapore
itinerary.detail: Fly from the UAE, transfer to your hotel, evening Marina Bay light show.

itinerary.title: Gardens & bay
itinerary.detail: Gardens by the Bay domes and Supertree Grove, afternoon at the ArtScience Museum or shopping on Orchard Road.

itinerary.title: Sentosa day
itinerary.detail: Universal Studios or S.E.A. Aquarium, cable car ride, beach sunset.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.detail: Morning hawker breakfast, transfer to Changi and fly home.

excluded: Universal Studios / attraction tickets (bookable on request)
travelInfo: Visa-free entry for many nationalities — we confirm for your passport
Great year-round; expect tropical showers
